workerResult.summary: Granular Grove Synth: glassmorphism granular toy. Drop any audio (or press D for a synthesized demo grove), auto-sliced into 8 onset regions (keys 1-8 seed the cloud). XY pad conducts position/grain-size with firefly canvas, sliders for density/pitch/spray/mix. Tap-tempo (T) drives a dotted-echo trail with feedback/mix/division. E exports an 8s webm loop via MediaRecorder. Fully keyboard-operable with visible focus, localStorage persistence, responsive to 375px. node --check clean, all DOM ids resolve.
